title: Fold finished steps in the run tree to one line each

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Frontend design review of 2026-10-25 (opus, from four owner screenshots; it did not read docs/dashboard.md or adj 149, so check the spec first). Finished steps in the run tree take two lines each, with a label line that restates the role (s27 implementer), which costs about 6 rows at 80x24. Fold finished steps to one line each and keep the label line only for the active step.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestFinishedStepIsOneLine.
- TestActiveStepKeepsItsLabelLine.
- TestFailedStepKeepsItsTask (so the reason is visible).
- Golden views.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first. 2. Fold finished steps. 3. Keep the active and failed steps in full. 4. Goldens and docs. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

"Label line" means the dim task line under a node (runtree.go, the `s.Task` line). Finished means phase `done` only. Stale, ended, unknown, wait and start steps and every failed step keep it, and the gate FAIL line stays. Update the Task-text sentence in docs/dashboard.md (about line 1397) to say a done step shows no task line.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks at the changed view in a live terminal at 100x30 and 80x24.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "Fold finished run-tree steps to one line".
